info.title: Pharmacy Management System API
info.description: Complete API documentation for Pharmacy Management System including admin, student, teacher, and payment modules

post.summary: Get departments by institute and semester
post.description: Retrieve departments using fn_admin_getdepartmentsbyinst
Retrieve all available designations using fn_admin_getalldesignation stored procedure
Retrieve all institutes using fn_admin_getallinstitutes_v1
Calls PostgreSQL stored function fn_get_ra_institute_list to retrieve all Re-Admission institutes.
Retrieve institute wise subject submission summary using fn_admin_getinstitutewisesummary
Retrieve examiner wise subject submission summary using fn_admin_examinerwisesummary
Retrieves all semesters list filtered by semester type. Calls: fn_admin_getallsemesters(p_admin_user_id, p_semester_type)
Save marks for one or multiple students using fn_admin_savestudentmarks_v3 stored procedure

post.summary: Save review subject marks in bulk
post.description: Loops through the marks array and calls fn_save_review_subject_marks for each item.
Retrieves all subject categories for a given semester. Calls: fn_admin_getallsubjectcategory(p_admin_user_id, p_semester)

post.summary: Get all subjects for a department
post.description: Retrieves all subjects for a specific department, semester, and subject category. Calls: fn_admin_getdeptallsubjects_v1

post.summary: Get subject details by semester and category
post.description: Calls fn_admin_getsubjects_details.
Save teacher information and assign multiple subjects using fn_admin_saveteacherinfo and fn_admin_saveteacherassignsubject_v1

Retrieves teachers assigned to subjects with filters by institute, department, subject, and semester. Use '0' or 0 for department_code, subject_code, semester_id to get all. Calls: fn_admin_getassignedteacherinfo

department_code.description: Department code filter ('0' for all departments)

subject_code.description: Subject code filter ('0' for all subjects)

semester_id.description: Semester ID filter (0 for all semesters)

post.description: Retrieves teachers who have entered marks for the selected institute, department, subject, exam year, and semester. Calls: fn_admin_getmarksenteredteachersinfo

200.description: Marks entered teacher information retrieved successfully

post.description: Deletes teacher information using fn_admin_deleteteacherinfo

Retrieves subject allocation summary for evaluators (internal/external examiners). Shows which evaluators are assigned to which subjects for marking. Calls: fn_admin_getevaluatorsubjectallocationsummary

message.example: Evaluator subject allocation summary retrieved successfully

post.summary: Get review evaluator subject allocation summary
post.description: Calls fn_admin_getreview_evaluatorsubjectallocationsummary.

post.summary: Assign a review subject to a teacher
post.description: Calls fn_admin_savereviewteacherassignsubject.

post.summary: Get review evaluator institute allocation summary
post.description: Calls fn_admin_getreviewevaluatorinstallocationsummary.

post.summary: Get list of RA (Re-Admission) students by institute code
post.description: Calls PostgreSQL stored function fn_get_ra_student_list to retrieve all Re-Admission students for a given institute code.

post.summary: Check if a student is eligible in exam
post.description: Calls PostgreSQL stored function fn_check_studenteligible_inexam_studentid to verify student eligibility, registration, roll number, and payment status for an exam.

admin_user_id.description: Admin User ID (defaults to auth user / student ID)

post.summary: Get reported against subject marks details by student registration number
post.description: Calls PostgreSQL stored function fn_getradetailslistbystudentregistartionnumber to retrieve subject-wise internal/external marks and obtained marks for a reported against student.

admin_user_id.description: Admin User ID (defaults to auth user / 1)

post.description: Generates OTP for admin users. Calls fn_generateotp to create OTP, then sends via SMS/Email based on user_type_id. Type 8/13→Email, Types 9/10/11/15→SMS, Type 12→Both. OTP expires in 2 minutes.

post.summary: Verify OTP and get authentication token
post.description: Validates OTP and generates authentication token. Calls fn_getlatestotpbyusername for validation, generates MD5 token (valid 4 hours), marks OTP as used via fn_updateuserotpbycontactno, and returns user details with token.

200.description: OTP verified successfully and token generated

400.description: Incorrect OTP or could not resolve contact

message.example: No OTP found. Please request a new OTP.

post.description: Initiate SBI ePay payment for institute admin (₹5 payment)
Retrieve student marks information using fn_admin_getstudentmarksinfo_v2 stored procedure. Use student_id=0 for all students or specific student_id for individual student.

student_id.description: 0 for all students, non-zero for specific student

post.description: Calls fn_admin_getreviewstudentmarksinfo. Use student_id 0 to retrieve all matching students.
